detail.title: Status Update: Project proj-divergent-values-01
detail.summary: Project proj-divergent-values-01 remains active but stalled due to a lack of relevant evidence in the current collection. Existing sources cover equine leptin, business process management, and urban mobility, none of which address value divergence in artificial intelligence. A new research action is queued to identify literature on stochastic processes in value formation.
